summary: Iteration 67 regression audit on user-creation/login flows + email-verification gate + email-delivery dashboard. Backend: 19/19 PASS + 1 documented xfailed bug (500 on /api/auth/register when role=resident + unit_number is sent without compound_id — Family pydantic validation fails). Frontend: legacy logins work, /app/compound renders all 6 tabs, super-admin panel + email-logs tab render. Two white-screen routes found: /app/profile and /app/security (React Router: No routes matched). data-testid='email-logs-tab' is missing on the super-admin tab (tab text '📧 سجل البريد' renders correctly but lacks the documented testid).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when role='resident' + unit_number provided WITHOUT compound_id. Root cause: /app/backend/routes/auth.py line 177 creates Family(compound_id=user_data.compound_id, ...) using the raw user_data.compound_id (which is None) instead of the resolved local `compound_id` variable (line 65) that has the 'default-compound' fallback. Fix: pass `compound_id` (the local var) to Family(...).

ui_bugs.issue: /app/profile route is not registered — console: 'No routes matched location /app/profile' → WHITE SCREEN (body text length = 0). Either add the route or update the request to point to the correct path.
/app/security route is not registered — console: 'No routes matched location /app/security' → WHITE SCREEN (body text length = 0).
Tab '📧 سجل البريد' renders but is missing data-testid='email-logs-tab'. The contract from main agent's request specifies this testid for automated tests; add it to the tab button element.

integration_issues.issue: All 3 admin/owner roles (testcompany2, superadmin, Owner_homeme) land on /select-account after login (multi-account selector). Not a white-screen — body renders — but means E2E tests must traverse this picker before reaching the actual dashboard. /app/super-admin & /app/compound are accessible by direct navigation post-login.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer reports width(-1) height(-1) on initial render (16 warnings) — minor; container layout still renders content.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/routes/auth.py line 177: change `Family(compound_id=user_data.compound_id, ...)` to use the local resolved `compound_id` variable so resident self-register doesn't 500 when client omits compound_id.

Register routes for /app/profile and /app/security (or remove from main agent's checklist if they are intentionally not user-facing routes). Currently both produce WHITE SCREEN due to unmatched route.
Add data-testid='email-logs-tab' to the '📧 سجل البريد' button in /app/frontend/src/components/SuperAdminPanel.js for E2E test stability.
(Optional) After fixing the register 500, remove the xfail marker on test_register_no_compound_resident_500_bug in iter67 test file.

rca_of_the_issue: WHITE SCREEN on /app/profile + /app/security: React Router emits 'No routes matched location' warning and renders empty body. These routes were specified in the test request but are not present in the frontend router config. EITHER they need to be added OR the request is referencing wrong paths (the existing routes appear to be /app/notifications, /app/analytics, /app/compound, /app/super-admin, etc., which all render fine). 500 on /api/auth/register: when a resident self-registers with unit_number but no compound_id, the register handler resolves compound_id='default-compound' locally (line 65) but then passes user_data.compound_id (still None) to Family(...), which fails pydantic str validation. Fix is a one-character change (compound_id instead of user_data.compound_id at line 178).
